title: Unofficial recovery benchmark backend rehearsal
publicClaim: Practice evidence only. This vendor-authored eight-case rehearsal validates the benchmark backend and operator workflow; it is not Benchmark v1.0 and must not be presented as an official competitor ranking.
inclusionRules: Run every declared case in manifest order for StillOpen.
For guided web tools, attempt every supported declared format and record unsupported formats explicitly.
Preserve a complete recovered output whenever the free or freemium workflow makes it downloadable.
Score product outputs only with the benchmark-owned validator.
exclusionRules: These project-authored practice cases may not support an official neutrality claim.
Paid-only tools are outside this rehearsal.
Paywalled, maintenance, unavailable, unsupported, and no-output outcomes are visible but may not be represented as technical repair failures.
Practice results may not be promoted as Benchmark v1.0 or as a finished public leaderboard.
